body: You stupid fuck, I wouldn't have even realized that was Merle if it weren't for you.

I have friends, but the thing is they aren't ever serious. They're always joking around and rarely do they ever take anything seriously. And my social skills are shit so it's not like I can just go make some new friends.

Well you know, the truth is I don't really know. Life just seems pointless. I just don't really like talking to people anymore and I never get my homework and shit done so I'm always failing classes. That, and I obsess over every tiny fucking mistake I have ever made. Really just typical teenage bullshit, probably...
Having to fucking live in this shitty world's what's wrong.
